findings.title: WASM client encrypts null into a real ciphertext where the Node client returns null
findings.label: valid

findings.title: Consumers' TypeScript resolves protect-ffi WASM types for stack's main-entry declarations
findings.label: valid
findings.note: tsconfig comment confirms protect-ffi 0.24 resolves to WASM types without the node condition, and stack's public types derive from protect-ffi, so consumers' resolution can differ.

findings.title: CLI/wizard auth 0.36 -> 0.38 upgrade breaks login or token fetch

findings.title: Hand-edited 0.18.0 version conflicts with changesets release flow
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Version hand-set to 0.18.0 while a pending minor changeset exists and no changeset covers the new subpath/dep bumps, so changesets will skip versions and omit changelog entries.
